tasks.title: Package mocker as docker image
tasks.description: The working directory contains Hello/ - a complete, working QaaS mocker project that INCLUDES A CUSTOM PROCESSOR. Hello.csproj references QaaS.Mocker + QaaS.Common.Processors (Version=*); Program.cs is the one-line "QaaS.Mocker.Bootstrap.New(args).Run();"; CustomOkProcessor.cs defines a custom transaction processor (class CustomOkProcessor : BaseTransactionProcessor<object>) that returns body 'CUSTOM-OK' with HTTP 200; hello.mocker.yaml serves GET /health on Port 8080 via a Stub whose Processor is CustomOkProcessor. Do NOT modify anything under Hello/ - the custom processor must be compiled INTO the image exactly as seeded. Create at the working-directory ROOT three files: (1) Dockerfile - multi-stage: stage 1 'FROM mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/sdk:10.0 AS build', WORKDIR /src, COPY . ., RUN dotnet restore Hello/Hello.csproj, RUN dotnet publish Hello/Hello.csproj -c Release -o /app/publish --no-restore (this compiles CustomOkProcessor.cs into the image); stage 2 'FROM mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/aspnet:10.0' (CRITICAL: aspnet, NOT runtime, FB s13#7), WORKDIR /app, COPY --from=build /app/publish ., ENTRYPOINT ["dotnet", "Hello.dll", "hello.mocker.yaml"]. Keep every Dockerfile comment on its OWN line (FB s13#18). The container listens on 8080 INTERNALLY (do NOT change it). (2) .dockerignore with at least bin/, obj/, *.md. (3) BUILD.md documenting exactly: build 'docker build -t qaas-image-e04 .', run 'docker run -d --name qaas-test-E04 -p 8126:8080 qaas-image-e04' (host 8126 maps to container 8080), smoke 'curl http://127.0.0.1:8126/health' expecting body 'CUSTOM-OK' (produced by the bundled custom processor), cleanup 'docker rm -f qaas-test-E04', plus one sentence on why the base image must be aspnet:10.0 (s13#7). The verify gate builds the image and curls host 8126 expecting 'CUSTOM-OK', proving the custom processor was compiled into the container.

verify.cmd: docker rm -f qaas-test-E04 2>$null | Out-Null; docker run -d --name qaas-test-E04 -p 8126:8080 qaas-image-e04 | Out-Null; $body=''; foreach($i in 1..30){ Start-Sleep 1; $c = (curl.exe -s http://127.0.0.1:8126/health 2>$null); if($c){ $body = ([string]$c).Trim() }; if($body -eq 'CUSTOM-OK'){ break } }; docker rm -f qaas-test-E04 | Out-Null; if($body -eq 'CUSTOM-OK'){ exit 0 } else { exit 1 }

acceptanceCriteria: aspnet:10.0 is used as the base image
failureModes: Using runtime:10.0 which has no HTTP host

goalOneSentence: Build and run containerized mocker image-custom-processor serving port 8126.
portContract: This is a docker-image scenario with a CUSTOM PROCESSOR baked in. The container's mocker listens on HTTP port 8080 INTERNALLY (the seed default - do NOT change it). The image is run mapping host 8126 -> container 8080 (docker run -p 8126:8080). The live gate curls http://127.0.0.1:8126/health expecting body 'CUSTOM-OK' (produced by the seeded CustomOkProcessor). Do NOT modify Hello/ and do NOT change the mocker Port - the container stays on 8080.
